mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the stretch receptors was most worthwhile because it showed how information from the arm complements sight, while clarifying what position feedback cannot tell you.

leastWorthwhile.text: Linking the motor nerves to the arm was clear but predictable; it added less new insight than the later feedback distinction.

surprise.text: The distinction between sensing the arm’s position with closed eyes and locating an unseen target sharpened my understanding of the feedback pathway.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The item descriptions and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it builds on these pathways with a similarly clear distinction. This chapter was easy to follow, though most combinations were predictable.
